audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 while Aurelion Sol wins 54.34% over 541 games, and the level chart hands Brand 6 of 7 stages.
audit.why: Brand out-ranges the Q channel early (Sear 1050, Pillar of Flame 900 vs Breath of Light 750), so levels 1-3 genuinely belong to him. But Astral Flight at 4 gives a flyby the 625-range Conflagration cannot answer, Falling Star at 6 gives a stun Brand has no dash out of, and from Rod of Ages the E clear plus permanent stardust take over. That is an even-to-favourable lane, not a 7/10.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10; chart Brand / Brand / Brand / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol on both layers.
sources: brief ownerKit + enemyKit ranges and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Item spikes contradict each other across layers: the full layer builds Rod of Ages / Seraph's / Archangel's, the content spikes and late text talk about Stormsurge and Shadowflame breakpoints.
audit.why: A reader gets two different builds on one page. The full layer's report[8] itemization is the authority here, so the content spikes were realigned to Rod of Ages / Archangel's.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text and late rewritten around Rod of Ages and Archangel's; breakdown.spikes names Rod of Ages, the 120s level-6 stun, and The Skies Descend.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Sear only stuns a target that is ALREADY ablaze, so the dodge that matters is Pillar of Flame / Conflagration, not the stun itself. Separately, breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and the missingInteractions entry (Brand's CC cancels your Q and W channels) was absent from the page.
audit.why: Brand's Q text: 'If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.' Aurelion Sol's Q and W both carry the channel flag ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'), so an 8s-at-rank-1 Sear deletes a Breath of Light channel or a mid-flight Astral Flight. Pillar of Flame also deals +25% to ablaze targets, and Blaze detonates itself at three stacks after 2 seconds.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.foe[0] rewritten to state ablaze-then-stun, the channel cancel, the +25% ablaze bonus, and real cooldowns (Sear 8s->6s, Pyroclasm 100s, Astral Flight 22s, black hole 12s).

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' is used twice as an Aurelion Sol ability name (spikes[1], spikes[3], and content late).
audit.why: Voice of Light is not in the kit. Aurelion Sol's abilities are Cosmic Creator (P), Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), Singularity/black hole (E), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.corrected: Replaced with Breath of Light (Q), Falling Star and The Skies Descend.
sources: ownerKit ability list in the brief

audit.whatIsWrong: content 'early' told the player to 'use E to reposition off his skillshots'.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's E is a stationary black hole with a pull and an execute — it is not a reposition tool. Astral Flight (W) is the movement ability.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to drop the black hole on the wave to clear from 750 instead of stepping up.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it (defect-catalogue item 3).
audit.why: This is the field that carries real cooldowns; generic text leaves the reader with nothing to time against.
audit.corrected: Sear 8s at rank 1 / 6s at rank 5, Pyroclasm 100s at rank 1, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (copy-paste bleed).
audit.why: The title promised the R anti-dive rule and the sub-half-health rule; the body explained the W flyby and the Q channel instead.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles, grounded in Brand's 625 E range and Blaze's 4-second burn.
sources: enemyKit E range 625, P text 'dealing damage over 4 seconds'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave was a template — 'you are the slowest, most killable mage in the game' says nothing about Brand.
audit.why: The actual wave rule here is range-driven: clear the back line from 750 so the wave dies outside Pillar of Flame's 900, and crash into his recall rather than into an available Sear.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the range numbers and the Blaze consequence.

edits.before: Brand out-pokes you from level 1 with Sear procs and Pillar splash, and because your Q needs commitment to charge he can walk-away punish every attempt to farm close. edits.before: Once you hit Stormsurge/Shadowflame breakpoints your Q collision burst and Voice of Light poke out-trade his DOT-based damage, and your ultimate's zone control keeps him from ever landing a full Pillar-Conflagration combo on your team. Play the long game — this matchup is a lane loss that becomes a teamfight win.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages and Archangel's are done, permanent stardust makes Breath of Light (Q) out-damage his Blaze ticks, and The Skies Descend drags him out of the cluster he needs for Pyroclasm bounces. Play the long game — this matchup is a hard lane that becomes a teamfight win outright.
